exposure: prior cesarean delivery in the first stage of labor
cesarean delivery in the second stage of labor
cohort: Parturients who underwent cesarean delivery due to non-progressive labor in the first or second stage between 1988 and 2013
finding: Prior cesarean delivery due to non-progressive labor in the second stage of labor (NPL2) was independently associated with adherent placenta in the subsequent delivery compared to cesarean delivery due to NPL1.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery due to non-progressive labor in the second stage was independently associated with adherent placenta in the subsequent delivery compared to cesarean delivery due to non-progressive labor in the first stage.
